data.title: Hallway, aerospace department
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Do you have a minute? It's about chapter two. Speaker 2: Of course, Professor Varenne. Speaker 1: The outline still mixes the thermal model with the test results. Send me a revised outline before our meeting on the 24th. Speaker 2: I'll send the revised outline before the 24th. Speaker 1: Also, the graduate office closes thesis-title registrations on the 31st. Speaker 2: I haven't registered mine yet. I'll do that this week. Speaker 1: Good.
